exact_source_observation: At least 2.2 billion people have a near or distance vision impairment
do_not_sum_with: all national visual-disability cells; Braille; audio; screen-reader cells
caveats: Most are over 50; impairment does not establish screen-reader use Braille literacy student status language or lack of accessible editions.
All-age count includes people outside the educational-product learner stratum and does not measure assistive-technology or accessible-format need.

source_locator: C-22 India Total In-Seeing age 5-19 row total persons
caveats: Includes attending formerly attending and never-attending groups; no causal claim connects nonattendance to inaccessible textbook formats.

source_locator: C-22 India Total In-Seeing age 5-19 row attending persons
do_not_sum_with: ACCPOP-VIS-INDIA-5-19-2011; all intervention edges in VIS-INDIA-5-19-2011
caveats: Attendance does not imply readiness for tertiary OpenStax or Open Logic content and the count does not partition low vision blindness screen-reader use or Braille literacy.

source_locator: C-22 India Total source-category row age 5-19 total persons
caveats: The historical label is transcribed solely for auditability. It is not a modern diagnostic definition and cannot be converted into plain-language users.

source_locator: C-22 India Total source-category row age 5-19 attending persons
caveats: No evidence identifies which learners would gain comfortable access from a plain-language companion or whether the target curriculum is relevant.

do_not_sum_with: every language territory and learner cell; all other delivery-axis interventions
caveats: Must be intersected with exact language territory learner curriculum and device/storage access. Offline people are not necessarily able to use a digital offline package.

source_locator: Total New Zealand population 2023 language table
caveats: Multiple response language ability is not first-language use and does not show inability to use existing English materials.

learner_stratum: age 3 and over reporting ability to use BSL
caveats: Ability includes many second-language users. Around 2600 report sign language as main language but not all are BSL users; that contextual value is not used as a lower bound.

learner_stratum: population age 3 and over reporting language learned in childhood
caveats: Narrow childhood-language measure likely differs from total users; it cannot be compared additively with ability measures or assigned to a written Spanish edition.

do_not_sum_with: all disability literacy and second-language populations
caveats: Neither WCAG COGA nor the plain-language intervention specification yields a count of people who would newly comprehend OpenStax or Open Logic.
Visual impairment prevalence cannot be converted to Braille literacy. Other languages and jurisdictions require their own Braille codes and evidence.

do_not_sum_with: visual impairment low-literacy TTS and signed-language populations
caveats: Audio preference low literacy and nonvisual access overlap but are not interchangeable; no source supports adding them.
